$comment: EXAMPLE VEX, CycloneDX 2.0. Vulnerability statements about the Keycloak 26.7.3 image, in the form a supplier publishes them. The product record points here under interface-disclosure#R2 by BOM-Link and SHA-256. ILLUSTRATIVE: the identifiers are not CVEs and describe no real vulnerability, and the upstream Keycloak project publishes no VEX. Each statement names the affected component by a BOM-Link into the companion SBOM, and the SBOM entry carries the package URL that the product record's I9 also names. That shared identifier is the join. The VEX is revised when knowledge changes; the CBOM is revised when the product changes (decision 0020).
